parameters.name: Eips
parameters.description: A list of IP addresses. The IP addresses must use the same protocol version. You can specify up to 100 IP addresses.

parameters.name: InternetSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the strict mode for access control policies. Valid values:

- **on**: Enables strict mode.

- **off**: Disables strict mode.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.
